A newline-only inline wrapper still separates the words on either side

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("Alpha<span style=\"white-space:pre\">\n</span>13", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
